title: IELTS Academic 21 - Listening Test 1 - Part 3
transcriptHtml:
LISTENING TRANSCRIPT - PART 3

💡 Audio-Track Sync: Bấm vào bất kỳ câu nào dưới đây để phát audio ngay đúng câu đó!

16:10PHIL: That lecture from the visiting speaker yesterday was good, wasn't it?
16:15LUCY: Yeah, I learned a lot from her about ocean biodiversity... but I especially like the way her lecture focused on more long-term issues.
16:54PHIL: The examples she gave were at a more global level and they really made it clear to me just how wide ranging the threats to ocean biodiversity are.
17:13LUCY: I'd have thought it was quite unusual to have so many experts working together.
18:03PHIL: And the description of improvements in systems used for tracking marine animals and things like robots were really interesting.
19:37but he didn't really provide much information to explain why.
19:50I watched to the end, but you're right, it was showing its age.
20:10Most of it was stating the obvious.
20:38but actually I ended up with a much better understanding of the issues.
20:49The article on metal toxicity was way above my head.
21:12though it presented a rather one-sided picture, I thought.
questionHtml:
Questions 21-22

Choose TWO letters, A-E.

A references to local problems | B broad focus of examples | C practical suggestions | D type of issues discussed | E implications for policy

21. First chosen letter:

Đáp án đúng: B hoặc D

22. Second chosen letter:

Đáp án đúng: B hoặc D

Questions 23-24

Choose TWO letters, A-E.

23. First chosen letter:

Đáp án đúng: C hoặc E (robots = new technology; experts = specialists).

24. Second chosen letter:

Đáp án đúng: C hoặc E

Questions 25-30

Choose SIX answers from A-H:

A. specialist audience | B. rather outdated | C. new danger | D. improve situation | E. not balanced | F. too predictable | G. insufficient evidence | H. clear explanation

25. Article on invasive lionfish:

Đáp án: G

26. Documentary on microplastics:

Đáp án: B

27. Podcast on ocean pollution:

Đáp án: F

28. Book on coastal ecosystems:

Đáp án: H

29. Article on metal toxicity:

Đáp án: A

30. Podcast on floating marine cities:

Đáp án: E
